Record provenance and coverage

Record the source and extraction date, the calendar period, filters, and column definitions. The extraction date tells you when you obtained the file. The covered period describes the events included. Keep the original file so you can repeat the checks.

Identify the row grain

Grain means what one row represents. A transaction table can have one row per sale. A line-item table can repeat the same transaction ID for several products. This distinction changes how you check duplicates and count sales.
